column3: “there they are” renders “they have been there.”
NASB puts verses 6–9 in parentheses and supplies “to”; the Hebrew reads “from Beeroth Bene-jaakan Moserah.”
“the tribe of Levi” renders “the tribe of the Levites.”
“like the first time” renders “like the former days.”
“proceed on your journey” renders “go to set out.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB reads “the Lord’s commandments” with a lowercase “Lord” for “Yahweh.”
“the highest heavens” renders “the heavens of the heavens.”
“your heart” renders “the foreskin of your heart.”
“does not show partiality” renders “does not lift up face.”
“as numerous as the stars of heaven” renders “like the stars of the heavens for multitude.”
